\n\nMedimos o saldo de créditos incluído:
We measure the balance of credits included in the subscription for the specified period. Extra purchased credits, prepaid balances, and additional usage billed separately are excluded from this percentage.

When credits are shared, eligible plan features draw from the same balance. The provider defines this coverage: Grok features and, when included in the plan, Grok Bot and eligible Cursor usage. The query returns an aggregate total; it cannot break down usage by feature or confirm which benefits are enabled on the account.

When the provider identifies Grok Build-specific credits, we measure only that coding quota. We do not add quotas from Chat, Imagine, Voice, Bot, Cursor, or other products. If the credit type is not provided, we do not assume any of these arrangements.
